# package timeline

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-modbus-trace/export/timeline"
```

Package timeline writes a trace's events as CSV or JSON Lines, one row or line per event, ordered by time (with a bounded reorder window) or in order of determination (ARCHITECTURE.md section 11, REQUIREMENTS.md L14).

## Constants

```go
const DefaultBuffer = 64 << 20
```

DefaultBuffer bounds the encoded rows held for reordering. When it is full the oldest row is written early; what then arrives older than it is written out of order and counted (Stats.Late).

```go
const DefaultWindow = 60 * time.Second
```

DefaultWindow is the reorder window of ByTime, in trace time.

## Variables

```go
var Columns = []string{"kind", "seq", "time", "conn", "client", "server", "unit", "tid", "function", "sub", "class",
	"status", "exception", "latency_ns", "flags", "warnings", "summary", "ranges",

	"request_first", "request_last", "response_first", "response_last",
	"role_source", "open", "close", "dir", "pos", "bytes", "reason", "note"}
```

Columns are the CSV columns, in order.

```go
var ErrUnknownFormat = errors.New("timeline: unknown format")
```

ErrUnknownFormat is wrapped by the error Write returns for a Format it does not know.
